title: Wordmark line morphs into a phone with a listening orb
summary: A two-bar mark shrinks and unfolds into a wordmark, a line splits it and widens into a white phone; a reading screen with word highlights gives way to an assistant screen with a big gradient orb, then a quiet closing line.
use_when: A mobile reading, listening or voice-assistant app with two hero screens
One continuous shot from logo to product, no cuts, silent autoplay
A soft pastel brand that wants calm, premium motion instead of fast cutting
Showing an AI or voice mode as an orb rather than a chat thread

look.type_style: wordmark: geometric grotesk, first word bold and second regular, sentence case, ~6 % H; phone UI: small sans labels and a serif body text; closing line: bold rounded grotesk ~3 % H, white

sfx.event: wordmark letters wiped on behind the moving bar
line widens into the phone body
orb grows on the assistant screen

structure.shot: two-bar mark, white, centred large on a blurred peach and slate-blue gradient field
structure.motion: mark holds to 0.27 s, then shrinks 1.00 -> 0.28 by 1.00 s, S-curve, closest easings.inOutSine ~22 fr (±0.25 s); slides left to sit where the wordmark will start

structure.shot: the small mark becomes the first glyph of a two-word wordmark that is wiped on left to right behind a thin vertical bar
structure.motion: bar appears 1.27 s right of the mark and moves right; letters revealed behind it, word one bold then word two regular, full by 1.77 s (~15 fr, ±0.25 s); bar gone at 1.77; hold 2.00

structure.shot: the two words part, a vertical line grows in the gap, words fade, the line fattens into a white rounded pill and then the phone body
structure.motion: 2.27 words slide apart ~0.1 W, line ~33 % H; 2.50 words faded, line ~68 % H; 2.77 line widens to a pill ~4 % W; 3.00 full phone silhouette ~7 % W x 67 % H; springs.layout (overshoot not measurable), ~8 fr per stage (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: phone shows a reader screen: title header, serif paragraph with the current words in dark bold and the rest faded, a progress bar and playback controls
structure.camera: background push-in 0.3-0.6 %/s; phone scale 1.00 -> 1.11 from 4.00 to 8.00 s (cell heights, ±3 %)
structure.motion: UI fades in over the white body 3.27 -> 3.77 (~15 fr, ±0.25 s); bold highlight advances word by word, about 2 words per second, through 8.00; progress bar fills left to right easings.linear

structure.shot: reader content fades out to a blank white phone with only the status bar
structure.camera: zoom -1.5 %/s in 9-10 s (motion.json), phone height steady
structure.motion: content opacity 1 -> 0 from 8.50 to 9.00 (~15 fr, ±0.25 s), easings.linear; blank hold 1 cell

structure.shot: assistant screen: header with a prompt label and book line, a gradient orb centre, a hint line and four suggestion chips above a mic and a talk button
structure.motion: screen fades in 9.27; orb grows ~0.35 -> 1.00 of its width by 9.77 (~15 fr), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); chips fade in by 10.27; hold; chips and hint fade out 12.50 -> 12.77

structure.shot: listening state: chips gone, the orb is larger and holds centre; only the header and the two round buttons remain
structure.camera: background push-in 0.3-0.5 %/s; phone scale 1.00 -> 1.21 from 13.00 to 22.00 s (cell heights, ±3 %)
structure.motion: orb grows ~1.00 -> 1.35 by 13.00 (springs.ui, overshoot not measurable); then holds, its two-colour linear gradient slowly shifts (breathing; amplitude not measurable at 4 fps)

structure.shot: the phone turns translucent and shrinks away into the gradient field
structure.motion: phone opacity 1 -> 0 from 22.77 to 23.77 (~30 fr, ±0.25 s), scale 1.00 -> 0.86, easings.inExpo suggested; empty field at 23.77

structure.shot: closing credit line, 3 words, white, centred on the empty gradient
structure.motion: words blur-in with a small rise, second part lags ~1 cell; settled 24.50 (~15 fr, ±0.25 s); stagger and blur radius not measurable; holds to the end

params.brand: brand.json: bg pair (peach + slate blue) for the gradient field, fg white, mark and wordmark
params.content.reader: reader screen: title, author line, one paragraph of public-domain or own text, highlight start word
params.content.assistant: assistant header label (<= 4 words), hint line, 4 suggestion chips (<= 5 words each)
params.content.close: closing line, <= 4 words, shown alone at the end
params.timing.listenHold: frames of the listening hold (default 300 = 10 s at 30 fps); the safest row to shorten
params.aspect: 16:9 measured; phone stays centred, so 9:16 and 1:1 recompose by scaling the phone

notes: One shot, zero cuts in cuts.json: every handover is continuous. Silent reference: all sfx are planned by the glue rule, not measured. Timings from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); entrance frame counts, spring choice and overshoot are suggestions, not measured. Phone scale numbers measured from sheet cell heights (±3 %); background zoom from motion.json. Proposed terms (not used as ids): bar-wipe wordmark (letters revealed behind a moving vertical bar, rows 2), line-to-device morph (row 3), reading highlight (word-by-word bold in a paragraph, row 4), listening orb (row 6-7).
